raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## What does this PR do?

Install cuBLAS 13.8.1 (archive version `13.8.1.7`) in the Megatron Bridge image, matching https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/7685. The final NeMo Framework image inherits this runtime from the Bridge image.

## Changelog

- Download the official CUDA 13 cuBLAS archive for x86_64 or Arm SBSA before building native dependencies.
- Replace the existing toolkit headers and cuBLAS/cuBLASLt libraries so current linker paths resolve to the updated runtime; retain the archive license and clean up temporary files.
- Expose `CUBLAS_VERSION` as a build argument and preserve the base image's cuBLAS when `PRESERVE_BASE_RUNTIME=True`.
- Document the new archive-version argument separately from the framework base image's existing apt-version argument.

Version metadata: https://developer.download.nvidia.com/compute/cublas/redist/redistrib_13.8.1.json.

## Validation

- [x] `uv run pre-commit run --all-files` in a container.
- [x] `bash .github/scripts/test_docker_dependency_layers.sh`.
- [x] Added shell block passes `bash -n`; `git diff --check` and `docker build --check` pass.
- [x] Built the added layer on NGC PyTorch 26.08 (x86_64): cuBLAS and cuBLASLt report 13.8.1, headers report 13.8.1.7, and a fresh PyTorch process naturally maps both updated libraries.
- [x] RTX 6000 Ada FP32, FP16, and BF16 matmul checks against CPU double-precision results pass (five iterations per dtype).
- [x] `PRESERVE_BASE_RUNTIME=True` retains byte-identical base cuBLAS libraries/headers; unsupported architectures fail with an explicit diagnostic.
- [x] x86_64 and Arm64 CI image builds passed; both logs confirm the `13.8.1.7` CUDA 13 archives were installed before native dependencies.
- [x] CI import checks, diffusion unit tests, and all three core unit-test shards passed.
- [x] All 84 L0/L1 functional jobs passed: 52 H100 jobs and 32 GB200 jobs, with no retries or quarantines.
- [x] [`CICD NeMo` run 36638276385](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/actions/runs/36638276385) passed on `66b1fa60d67109fe6281faf9443d98401d6f360b`: 102 successful jobs, including both image builds, import checks, all unit-test shards, all 84 L0/L1 functional jobs, and coverage aggregation. All required PR checks are green.

## CI failures deferred

None.

@@ -62,6 +62,30 @@ ENV MBRIDGE_PRESERVE_BASE_RUNTIME=${PRESERVE_BASE_RUNTIME} \
     RDMA_CORE_HOME=/opt/rdma-core/build \
     LD_LIBRARY_PATH="/usr/local/cuda/lib64/:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH"
 
+ARG TARGETARCH
+ARG CUBLAS_VERSION=13.8.1.7
+RUN bash -euxo pipefail <<"EOF"
+    if [ "$MBRIDGE_PRESERVE_BASE_RUNTIME" = "True" ]; then exit 0; fi
+    # Match the cuBLAS update in NVIDIA/Megatron-LM#7685.
+    case "${TARGETARCH}" in
+        amd64) CUBLAS_ARCH=x86_64 ;;
+        arm64) CUBLAS_ARCH=sbsa ;;
+        *) echo "Unsupported TARGETARCH for cuBLAS: ${TARGETARCH}" >&2; exit 1 ;;
+    esac
+    CUBLAS_ARCHIVE="libcublas-linux-${CUBLAS_ARCH}-${CUBLAS_VERSION}_cuda13-archive"
+    CUBLAS_TMP=$(mktemp -d)
+    trap 'rm -rf "${CUBLAS_TMP}"' EXIT
+    curl -fLSs --retry 3 -o "${CUBLAS_TMP}/cublas.tar.xz" \
+        "https://developer.download.nvidia.com/compute/cublas/redist/libcublas/linux-${CUBLAS_ARCH}/${CUBLAS_ARCHIVE}.tar.xz"
+    tar -xJf "${CUBLAS_TMP}/cublas.tar.xz" -C "${CUBLAS_TMP}"
+    # Replace the toolkit copies so existing linker paths use the updated libraries.
+    CUDA_ROOT="${CUDA_HOME:-/usr/local/cuda}"
+    cp -a "${CUBLAS_TMP}/${CUBLAS_ARCHIVE}/include/." "${CUDA_ROOT}/include/"
+    cp -a "${CUBLAS_TMP}/${CUBLAS_ARCHIVE}/lib/." "${CUDA_ROOT}/lib64/"
+    install -Dm644 "${CUBLAS_TMP}/${CUBLAS_ARCHIVE}/LICENSE" "${CUDA_ROOT}/doc/cublas/LICENSE"
+    ldconfig
+EOF
+
